periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation with the primary axis tilted inward at approximately 45 degrees toward the nasal bridge.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated teardrop morphology with a height-to-width ratio significantly greater than 1.0.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with the inferior margin extending substantially toward the maxillary region.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High; the dark band encompasses the entire shoulder girdle and proximal forelimb segments.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide horizontal separation across the cranial crown, roughly equivalent to twice the individual pinna width.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Semi-circular convex curvature with slight flattening at the superior-most edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced ventral discoloration consisting of a brownish-tan hue on the chest fur contrasting with the white cranial pelage.
